EmailTemplate.textOnly:
keep the good going®
The virtual sample you requested is attached, and that is one good-looking promotional product!
Your virtual will remain open for thirty (30) days so if you have any revisions please be sure to send them over within 30 days from the original received date. We do our best to ensure virtuals are as exact as possible, but proportions, precise placement and colors may not be a 100% accurate representation of the final product.
If you would like a revised virtual sample, please attach the previous version. If that is not available, including the file name will help with accuracy and turn time.
Let us know if there’s anything else you need to close this order. When an order does result from this virtual sample, please send your purchase order and include the virtual sample that was created for you to orders@kooziegroup.com.
All the best, The Koozie Group Customer Care Krew
Please Note: 1-5 virtual sample requests will be available within 24-48 hours, 6+ requests may incur additional time Some requests may not be available due to “Ship From” status
kooziegroup.com You can check order status and inventory, estimate shipping, create a virtual sample or access case studies, test reports, images and templates. It’s all there!
